priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: When a consumer invokes the returned cleanup function, the registered message handler remains active. Repeated attach/dispose cycles therefore retain listeners and can produce duplicate processing and side effects.

findings.title: [P1] Clear the polling interval during cleanup
findings.body: The interval handle is discarded and cleanup does nothing. After disposal, `refresh` continues running indefinitely, retaining stale callbacks and potentially keeping the Node.js process alive.

findings.title: [P1] Restore socket listener removal during cleanup
findings.body:
The returned cleanup function no longer unregisters the message handler. After consumers dispose an attachment, stale handlers continue processing messages, and repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate listeners and duplicate side effects.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Clear the polling interval during cleanup
findings.body:
The interval handle is discarded and the returned cleanup function does nothing. Polling therefore continues indefinitely after disposal, repeatedly invoking stale refresh callbacks and potentially keeping a Node.js process alive.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
